app.name: Orbit
root.short: Orbit — cloud certificate orchestration and inspection
status.short: Read-only inventory of certificates, resources and to-dos
clean.short: Remove certificates no cloud resource uses
account.short: Manage Tencent Cloud accounts and credentials
doctor.short: Environment self-check: config, credentials, access, locales
flag.products: Products to use (comma separated, e.g. cdn,teo)
flag.dry_run: Only build the plan; never write to the cloud
flag.fail_on_changes: Exit with code 3 when plan mode found changes
flag.include_free: Allow cleaning free certificates (off by default)
flag.backup_dir: Directory used to back up before deletion
flag.demo: Use built-in demo data (no Tencent Cloud access)
flag.experimental_write: Allow strategies that are not verified yet
flag.no_tui: Disable the TUI and print plain text
plan.title: Execution plan
plan.empty: Nothing to do: every domain already uses the best certificate.
plan.summary: {total} change(s): {apply} to apply, {uptodate} up to date, {nocert} without a usable certificate
clean.title: Cleanup plan
clean.reason.not_superseded: no better certificate for its domains (may still be in use)
clean.reason.free: free certificates are not cleaned by default
msg.plan_only: The above is a dry run; nothing was written. Re-run with --yes to apply.
doctor.title: Environment self-check
account.none: No account registered yet; run orbit account add first.
account.exists: Account {alias} already exists; add --force to overwrite.
err.credentials_mode: Credential file is too permissive (mode {mode}); run chmod 600 {path}
err.accounts_ambiguous: Multiple accounts found and this is not an interactive terminal; use --accounts or --all-accounts.
err.provider_unimplemented: The {platform} provider is not implemented yet (arrives in M1); use --demo for sample data.
err.no_accounts: No account is registered in the configuration.
err.invalid_products: Unsupported product: {value} (this batch supports: cdn, teo)
err.gate_experimental: Strategy {strategy} is not verified yet; pass --enable-experimental-write.
account.add.short: Register an account and store its credentials
config.set.short: Set a configuration value, e.g. language=en-US
core.reason.first_bind: the domain has no certificate yet
core.reason.no_cert: no usable certificate matches this domain
core.reason.edgeone_free_cert_kept: domain uses an EdgeOne free certificate; kept by configuration
core.reason.experimental_blocked: strategy is not verified yet; pass --enable-experimental-write
clean.reason.in_use: still referenced by a cloud resource
err.account_needs_input: Cannot read credentials non-interactively; use --from-stdin or environment variables.
